mechanism: Foscarnet causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia); lansoprazole reduces gastric acid and may impair absorption of minerals, compounding electrolyte depletion risk.
action: Monitor renal function, serum electrolytes (calcium, magnesium, phosphate) closely; ensure adequate hydration during foscarnet therapy; consider magnesium and calcium supplementation; use PPI cautiously or consider alternative acid suppression if possible.
